input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他找很多植物：找到，找look for vs.找到find

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “古代的时候”   Formula: 在 + historical time period   Correct: “在古代”   “在古代” is the natural way to begin a story set in ancient times.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。”   Formula: First mention: name + identity/description   Correct: “在古代，有一个叫神农的男人，他觉得植物很有意思。”   It is clearer to introduce the character’s name when he first appears.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了”   Formula: Subject + 吃了……以后 + body part + 疼得 + degree complement   Correct: “有的植物吃了以后，他的肚子疼得很厉害。”   “疼死了” is very strong and literally suggests that he died. “疼得很厉害” means “hurt badly” and fits the story better.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “可是有的吃了以后很舒服”   Formula: Subject + 吃了……以后 + 身体/感觉 + 很 + adjective   Correct: “可是有的植物吃了以后，他觉得身体很舒服。”   Adding “植物” and “他觉得身体” makes the meaning clearer.
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他找很多植物。”   Formula: Subject + verb + 了 + quantity + noun   Correct: “他找了很多植物。”   Use “了” because he completed the action of finding many plants.

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
The character should be identified as 神农 when he is first introduced, rather than only after a pronoun has been used.
疼死了 can idiomatically mean that the stomach hurt extremely badly and is acceptable here.
The clause needs to make clear that he, not the plants, feels comfortable after eating them.
找了 means that he searched for many plants, while the intended completed result is 找到很多植物.
